title: How to manage customers' Earnings in Lending (Loans Management)

posts.name: Shan Ruan
posts.cooked:
Hello everyone!
I am working as a private money lender. I borrow money from some people, I offer them some interest, then I lend the money to others with higher interest. With ERPNext Loan Management (now is “lending” - a standalone app) I could manage the money I lend out to people. But I don’t know how to manage the money I borrow from the others, and it looks like ERPNext Loan Management doesn’t have such feature yet. Please anyone if you are facing the same problem or have any experience in this field please share your experience. I appreciate all answers.
Thank you so much!

posts.name: Shan Ruan
posts.cooked:
This is what I got from ChatGPT:

As a private money lender, it’s important to have a comprehensive system in place to manage both the money you lend out and the money you borrow from others. While ERPNext Loan Management may not have a built-in feature specifically for managing the money you borrow, there are several options you can consider to address this issue. Here are a few suggestions:

  1. Separate Accounting System: You can maintain a separate accounting system to track the money you borrow. This could be as simple as using a spreadsheet or utilizing accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero. You can record the details of the borrowed funds, including the lenders, interest rates, repayment terms, and any other relevant information.

  2. Customization: If ERPNext allows for customization or integration with other applications, you may be able to customize the Loan Management module or integrate it with another module that handles the borrowing side. You can consult with a developer or the ERPNext community to explore such possibilities.

  3. Dedicated Loan Management Software: Consider using a dedicated loan management software that provides comprehensive functionality for both lending and borrowing activities. There are several commercial loan management software options available in the market that can handle both sides of your business. Research and evaluate different solutions to find one that suits your specific requirements.

  4. Manual Tracking: If you have a limited number of lenders and borrowings, you can opt for manual tracking using spreadsheets or other tools. Create a system where you record the details of each borrowing transaction, including the lenders, interest rates, and repayment terms. Regularly update and reconcile this information to keep track of your borrowings.

Remember, it’s crucial to maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with relevant regulations when managing borrowed funds. If you’re unsure about any legal or financial aspects, it’s advisable to consult with a financial advisor or attorney who specializes in lending and borrowing activities.

posts.name: Neeraj Sati
posts.cooked: To manage borrowed funds in ERPNext, you can use the “Accounting” module to record liabilities and interest payments. Create a liability account for each lender and record transactions like disbursed loans and interest accruals. You may also consider customizing the ERPNext Loan Management app or integrating it with other financial management tools to track both lending and borrowing effectively. Alternatively, explore dedicated loan management software with dual tracking capabilities.

As a private money lender, your business involves managing both the money you borrow from others and the money you lend out at a higher interest. While ERPNext Loan Management (now called “Lending”) is an excellent tool for tracking the loans you make to others, it doesn’t yet provide a straightforward solution for managing the borrowed capital. This gap can present challenges when it comes to keeping track of liabilities, interest payments on borrowed funds, and ensuring that your margins are protected.

One solution could be to customize ERPNext or add a third-party app to handle the borrowing side of your business. You can create custom fields for tracking borrowed amounts, interest rates, and repayment schedules, similar to how you track lending transactions. Another option is to explore dedicated platforms like Finanta, which provides end-to-end commercial lending solutions with capabilities to handle both sides of lending operations, including managing borrowed funds and ensuring transparency and compliance. Finanta’s solution can help you streamline the process, improve risk management, and offer better financial insights into your lending activities. Their platform offers the flexibility you may need to track both your liabilities (borrowed funds) and assets (lending funds) in one unified system.
